tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere, the site header, the special tone's fill and every text colour's darkest partner. ink, body, muted, accent and link all read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The docs header, the docs feedback strip, the phone 'On this page' box and the previous-page link. ink, body and muted read on it.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and the reeve.toml editor. Code in body, comments in muted, keys and numbers in link, table headers in accent.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section and list rules, table rules, the card tone's border, the meter track, the special tone's dot grid. Decorative only (1.39:1 on bg), so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of dark inputs, selects, ghost buttons, the Menu button and menus, and the special tone's border. 1.74:1 on bg: below the 3:1 WCAG asks of a control's edge. #636975 would reach 3:1 on bg and card-bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text and button labels on bg, surface, card-bg, card-chip, tint-bg and code-bg (11.9:1 or more). Also the light fill of the ink tone and the card backs.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, section intros, table cells and code on bg, surface, card-bg and code-bg (9.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, kickers, footer headings, captions, code comments and placeholders in dark fields. On bg, surface, card-bg, card-chip, tint-bg and code-bg (4.69:1 or more). Never on a light fill (2.55:1 on ink).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: bracket marks, [n] tags, the current-page underline, primary button fills, the CTA band, the meter fill. As text on bg, card-bg, card-chip, tint-bg and code-bg (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an accent fill: the primary button's label, CTA band copy (7.07:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons on dark grounds: bg, card-bg and tint-bg (8.8:1 or more). On light fills use back-link.

tokens.name: link-hover

tokens.name: focus

tokens.name: focus-on-light

tokens.name: badge-bg
